pages.title: Tumour Nodule
pages.text: A hard lump in the growth. Found in the Tumour of Inner Space. Mined, it gives Tumour Specimens; tumour mass and specimens lay more.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the rock (mine it for its drop).$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inner Space.
